tool_suggestions.title: Subscription Management Dashboard
tool_suggestions.prompt: Create a comprehensive dashboard to manage and track user subscriptions, billing cycles, and credit usage.
features: View and update user subscription tiers and details
Track credit usage and remaining balance
Generate and manage billing cycle reports
Automate notification alerts for expiring subscriptions

tool_suggestions.title: Voice Generation Analytics Explorer
tool_suggestions.prompt: Develop an analytics explorer tool to visualize audio generation data and performance metrics for decision-making.
features: Visualize audio generation trends over time
Track processing status and error statistics
Drill down into specific user and project data
Filter and export analytical reports for review

tool_suggestions.title: API Usage Monitoring Console
tool_suggestions.prompt: Build a console to monitor and analyze API request statistics, enabling optimization of usage and resource allocation.
features: Detect and alert on high latency or failure rates
Track individual user API usage patterns
